_comment: Python data types. Load it with: index.html?deckUrl=./deck.datatypes.json — each category carries a LIST of values, so a parcel shows a random one and you cannot just memorise a single label per bin. The delimiters are the whole lesson: 42 is an int, "42" is a str, 2 is an int but 2.0 is a float.
